svg.title: Five things that have to be true for a new feature, placed by how much it depends on each and how much you know.
svg.desc: A grid with two axes. Up means the idea depends on it more; right means you have less evidence and more of a guess. Five assumptions about letting people order from two stores in one delivery are placed on it. Two pickups stay on time, and the app can show both stores, sit top left: the idea depends on them, and there is evidence. People find it at checkout sits bottom left. People pay a second fee sits bottom right: a guess, but it matters less. One sits top right, where the idea depends on it most and you know least: people want two stores in one order. It is marked "Test this first," highlighted.
